events.comment: The content (chapters, archangels, shadow-thoughts, gifts…) comes from assets/data/content.json, built by tools/build-content.mjs. The save lives in the browser storage and is merged over the defaults of the global variable Save.

A chapter starts: its place (colours, floor painting), the chosen archangel with his own gift at level 1, the HUD and the intro card. Gifts of the run start from zero; the Fruits of the Spirit are lasting.
Props: ruins of the inner world, scattered on the ring, never at the centre where the angel starts.
The intro card: the place, the chapter, its lie, and the archangel who keeps watch.

events.comment: Everything the archangel, the gifts of this run, the virtues and the Fruits of the Spirit change, recomputed when something is taken. step(level, n) is 1 from level n on.
Rozmnożenie chlebów: one more missile per level (or a wider pool, a wider cloud).
Shields of faith and tongues of fire: as many objects as the gift asks for.

Arrows move by themselves; WASD is mapped onto the same controls. On touch screens the joystick (left thumb) drives the same Top-down movement behavior. The archangel's painting follows the light at his feet.
Standing still is prayer: the gift acts and the prayer grows (Ps 46,11).
Grief weighs: walking through it slows the angel (it does not wound).

Stillness (or the Mendi band, MendiFocus extension) and broken shadows fill the prayer. Full, it can be prayed (E / K / the flame button): each archangel has his own. The Prayer is the archangel's, given by God; it is never Christ's presence on demand.

events.comment: Gabriel's globe: when it ends, an evolved lantern bursts into light.
Raphael's vessel spills a pool where it lands (or where it meets a shadow).
Raphael is a physician on the road: a heart comes back every 45 s. Balm pools heal a little at a time.

Endless Puncher: strike (Space / J / the star button / a click) when a shadow is within reach. Strikes in a row build a combo that multiplies damage and light; a strike at nothing breaks it and costs a moment.
The stone always flies at the strongest shadow in range (the one with the most strength left).
Each shadow moves by its archetype (Content.enemies): chase, circle, charge, drift, tank, split, blink, ranged, gentle. Slowed shadows (incense, prayer, balm) move at SpeedNow.
Burning (Uriel's flame): strength drains while the fire lasts.
A hit squashes the painting for a moment.
Circle: orbit for a while, then strike.
Charge: walk, wind up (a moment to strike it first!), dash.
Drift: come close, then hover sideways; loneliness and shame keep their distance.
Blink: anxiety and doubt vanish and reappear somewhere near.
Ranged: the Accuser keeps away and throws fiery arrows (Ef 6,16).
Grief is not an enemy: weapons pass through it. Standing still beside it, the angel keeps it company until it turns into light.
Touching a shadow wounds the angel (unless grace still protects it); grief only weighs.
A strong shadow carries its thought in words above it, so it can be recognised.
A shadow whose strength is gone breaks: light flies out and a true sentence rises in its place.
Reliquary (left by a strong shadow): one gift at once, an evolution first if one is ready.

Each level pauses the fight and offers up to three cards (HolyHoly::DrawChoices): gifts (weapons) and virtues, four slots of each. A gift at its last level with its paired virtue evolves: that golden card comes first. A short delay keeps a running key press from picking blindly. Rerolls and "let it go" (one heart) give control over the pool.
Three waves of about a minute; shadows come from beyond the edge of the view, faster as the wave goes on. Between waves: the Sabbath, with a discernment card (name how a thought lies).

events.comment: Praise: after the stronghold, light rains on the angel for a few seconds (Heroes vs Hordes' coin rush, as joy rather than greed). Then the healing scene with Christ.

No game over: when the shadows overwhelm, the person falls and Christ reaches out a hand (Mt 14,31). The player only responds: "Take His hand". Grace grows with each fall: the stronghold gets weaker, the wave gives more time.

events.comment: Shock waves: a ring of light that grows to its radius and vanishes. Glows: the light a broken shadow leaves.
The music follows the fight: the chapter's piece, more layers with more shadows, the boss scene for the stronghold (Psalm150 extension).

Top left: the archangel's portrait, hearts and prayer; below, the four gifts and four virtues. Top centre: level and a thick light bar, the chapter; under it the stronghold. Top right: wave and pause. Bottom right: the prayer button with the archangel's icon. Bottom centre: focus.
Touch controls sit by the screen edges whatever the width.
